input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only cap in the Agreement (p0077, at the end of Section 12) protects TrueLink alone and is further narrowed to matters arising under Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11. Our liability is left entirely uncapped, including under the very broad Section 12(a) indemnity ("Client shall indemnify and hold TrueLink ... harmless from and against all claims, actions, expenses, losses, and liabilities"), which is squarely in walk-away territory (Customer uncapped while Vendor is capped). Searches for "liability", "aggregate" and consequential/indirect damages return nothing else: no mutual cap, no mutual damages exclusion, and carve-outs only for TrueLink's own gross negligence or willful misconduct, with nothing for indemnification or confidentiality. The fallback therefore fails on mutuality and on the carve-out set. Our redline takes the fallback position with the shortest edit to the existing sentence: the cap becomes mutual and Agreement-wide, retaining the existing 12-months-of-hosting-and-support-fees basis, with carve-outs for either party's indemnification obligations, confidentiality breach, gross negligence and willful misconduct. Preferred-only refinements we have not pressed here (a USD 1,000,000 floor, "paid or payable", a mutual indirect/consequential damages exclusion, and carve-outs for data protection/security, fraud and IP infringement, plus excluding Client's payment obligations from capped damages) remain available if TrueLink prefers to move to our preferred wording.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
mappings.quote: EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.

mappings.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.

proposal.summary: Make the Section 12 liability cap mutual and Agreement-wide at 12 months' hosting and support fees, with mutual carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap, so we have made the cap apply to both parties across the Agreement: our liability (including under the broad Section 12(a) indemnity) is currently unlimited while TrueLink's is capped. Indemnification obligations, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct sit outside the cap for both parties.
